bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money for a grant to SEWA-AIFW.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $250,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to SEWA-AIFW to provide workforce development services. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: $250,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $250,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to SEWA-AIFW to provide workforce development services. This is a onetime appropriation.
